the development of a new computational tool for rarefied gas dynamics, based on a hybrid method that combines the Boltzmann equation and the compressible Euler equations.
the development of a numerical method to solve the Boltzmann equation in the context of rarefied gas flows.
the development of a new hybrid method for hydrodynamical and kinetic flow, based on a non-stationary domain decomposition algorithm.
